definition: knowing what is going on around you
description: At a sunny riverside picnic under a weeping willow, with wooden rowing boats moored on the water, a young woman with red hair, in a blue crop top and a long cream skirt, kneels on the rug biting a sandwich and glancing sideways, one arm stretched out behind her. Right behind her a brown and white goat holds a cardboard cake box in its mouth and walks along. In front two friends lie on the rug laughing over plates of sandwiches, and the young man looks up at the goat. A white jug and a wicker basket stand on the rug.

taps.phrase: to carry off a cake box
